title: Qlik Engine Document CPU Hotspots
dataSources: Qlik Sense logs (`qlik:scheduler`, `qlik:engine`, `qlik:proxy`), QRS API task/audit (`qlik:qrs`), and Qlik Cloud events.
app: Qlik Sense logs via Universal Forwarder; Qlik Repository Service (QRS) API and Qlik Cloud REST API via HEC scripted inputs; QlikView/NPrinting event logs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:engine
| stats avg(cpu_pct) as avg_cpu, max(cpu_pct) as max_cpu, sum(calc_time_ms) as calc_ms by app_name
| where max_cpu>80
| sort - max_cpu
description: Attributes Qlik engine CPU consumption to specific apps so administrators can find the documents whose expensive calculations starve the node during peak hours.
value: A single heavy Qlik app can degrade the whole engine node; per-app CPU attribution guides optimisation or node placement.
implementation: Ingest engine performance logs; schedule every 10 minutes and review the heaviest apps with their owners.
visualization: Table of app by CPU, heat map of engine load.
grandmaExplanation: We find the Qlik apps that work the server hardest so they can be tuned before they slow everyone down.
